jobs.description: Reach Truck Operator | DHL Supply Chain | Weert Are you an experienced reach truck operator looking for a stable full-time job in logistics? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert and become part of a professional warehouse team working in a modern and international logistics environment. As a Reach Truck Operator, you will play an important role in keeping the warehouse running efficiently. You will safely move, store, and retrieve goods while making sure products are handled accurately and on time. Wie zoeken we? Previous experience operating a reach truck. A valid reach truck certificate is an advantage. Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule. (06:00 - 15:00 & 15:00 - 00:00) Good command of English, both spoken and written. Experience with other warehouse equipment such as EPT, OPT, or forklift is an advantage. Reliable, motivated, and comfortable working in a warehouse environment. Wat bieden wij je? €15.32 gross per hour. Shift allowance for working in shifts. (30%) Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per working day. Annual salary increases in line with the applicable Collective Labour Agreement (CLA). Good onboarding, training, and support to help you succeed. Excellent opportunities for career development and internal growth. A stable full-time position with one of the world's leading logistics companies. Functieomschrijving Operate a reach truck safely and efficiently in the warehouse. Move and store products in the correct warehouse locations. Pick and retrieve goods from different storage locations. Transport materials and products between warehouse areas. Keep the warehouse clean, safe, and well organized. Follow all DHL safety, quality, and operational procedures.

An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow.
